reuse_scope: Generic forged fittings/brackets/hoops and lead sheet/flashing; independent two-variant shader, no prop UV bake
shader_contract: One opaque material with two standard BC/N/ORM2m sets. UV0=physical metres/2; UV1.x=role (0iron/1lead), constant per face; Alpha1 unlinked. NormalMap basis UV0. Six separate image resources avoid cross-variant atlas mip bleeding. Native material factory must implement explicit variant binding.
iron_recipe: Source joint-free .5m square atpixel(186,174), registered .4m overlap repeat/.1m seam band, tiled5x over2m. Linear-albedo and roughness high-pass sigma.025m; normal-slope high-pass sigma.015m. Legacy-library mean albedo/roughness/metallic set artist blackened coating; fine scanned detail retained. Not unchanged scan BRDF/calibrated oxide or exact legacy shader. V1 broad-sheet wear rejected.
lead_recipe: Retains reviewed constant linearBC(.18,.195,.20), effectiveMetallic.25; artist-estimated periodic roughness.65..70/correlation sigma.006m and20micrometre peak-to-peak height/sigma.0035m. Reproducible seed614029. Not a scanned lead surface or exact Blender world-noise equivalence.
normal_convention: OpenGL; explicit normal green flip needed on native DirectX import
ORM: R AO/G roughness/B metallic; source ARM channels retained for iron, unoccluded AO1 for lead
v2_iron_finish_qualification: Broad sheet-corrosion albedo/roughness/normal variations removed with periodic Gaussian .025/.015m. Fine scanned structure retained; basecolour and mean metallic/roughness match legacy library averages. Artist-authored blackened coating, not unchanged photographic BRDF or calibrated oxide.
known_remaining: Source numerical/image QA, independent actual views, UV1/basis true FBX transport, whole-cottage physical chart conversion, six-slot/library/native validation
